description.value: The Malakwa Supermarket & Liquor Store is a community anchor in the small settlement of Malakwa, sitting along the Trans-Canada Highway roughly midway between Sicamous and Revelstoke. Beyond groceries and liquor it stocks hardware items and sells fuel, and it is one of the very few commercial stops in this rural stretch of the corridor. Touring cyclists will find it a practical all-in-one resupply point in an otherwise sparse service area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The community website at malakwa.ca/malakwa-supermarket/ confirms an active business at the OSM address, describing it as offering groceries, fuel, liquor, hardware items, and fishing and hunting licenses and gear. Basic groceries are confirmed by the explicit website text; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the content. The OSM name 'Malakwa Supermarket' differs from the website's consistent use of 'Malakwa Supermarket & Liquor Store', and the website supplies a phone number absent from the OSM record.
